# coloss (Codex CLI entry)

This is the Codex entry point for the FUSION `coloss` skill. **It is a pointer, not the skill.** The full protocol, including every rule, failure mode and verified example, is in `SKILL.md` next to this file.

Codex does not inline markdown imports ([openai/codex#17401](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/17401)), so nothing below is a substitute for reading it. **Read `SKILL.md` with your file-read tool before acting on this skill**, and do not answer from this summary alone.

## When this skill applies

Drive COLOSS, the complex-scaled optical and Coulomb scattering solver (Liu Junzhe, Lei, Ren; CPC 311, 109568, 2025). Write, run, and verify COLOSS input for two-body elastic scattering with local or Perey-Buck nonlocal optical potentials, computing S-matrices and cross sections by complex scaling. Use for 跑coloss, COLOSS input, complex scaling scattering, 复标度散射, bound-state technique scattering, S-matrix from Lagrange-Laguerre basis.
